title: Website builder
subtitle: Build your landing page from sections. Changes are saved as a draft.
draftNote: Edits only change your draft. The live website is not affected until you publish.

autosave.quota: Browser storage is full. Remove or replace large images, otherwise your latest changes are not saved.
autosave.unavailable: Could not save the draft in this browser.

template.title: Template

descriptions.classic: Best for most shops: a familiar page with a menu bar at the top.
descriptions.quicklinks: Best for tiny studios and Instagram visitors: one narrow column of big buttons.
descriptions.bookingrail: Best for selling workshops: a booking card stays visible next to your story.
descriptions.floatingcards: Best for a soft, friendly look: every section floats as its own card.
descriptions.sidebar: Best for shops with a lot to show: a menu that stays on the left.
descriptions.journey: Best for first-time visitors: a step-by-step path from discover to book.
descriptions.magazine: Best for craft and design studios: big headlines and numbered chapters.
descriptions.bento: Best for visual shops: photos, workshops and info as a mosaic of tiles.
descriptions.appstyle: Best for visitors on phones: tabs that show one topic at a time.
descriptions.cinematic: Best for striking photos and video: dark, full-screen sections.

template.hint: Pick the page layout you like at a glance. Switching never deletes your text, photos or colours.
template.confirmFor: You are about to switch to the {name} template.
template.keepsText: all your text, photos, videos and the colours you set for individual sections.
template.changesText: the page layout (how the page is arranged), section order, section styles, theme colours, font and spacing follow the new template. Your logo and favicon stay.
template.hidden: Not part of the new template but kept hidden (they have content): {names}.

sections.title: Sections
sections.footerLocked: The footer is required and always stays last.
sections.dndInstructions: Press space to pick up a section, use the arrow keys to move it, then press space to drop it. Press escape to cancel.

theme.title: Theme
theme.fontHint: All listed fonts fall back to system fonts that support Vietnamese, Korean and Japanese.
theme.paletteHint: A palette fills the colours below. You can change any colour afterwards.
theme.buttonNote: Button text colour is chosen automatically (white or dark) for the best contrast on the primary colour.

publish.title: Publish
publish.suspended: This website is suspended. Contact support to restore it.
publish.pending: Your website was submitted and is waiting for review. You can keep editing the draft.
publish.publishHint: Publishing makes the current draft live immediately.
publish.fixErrors: Fix {count, plural, one {# section} other {# sections}} marked as needing attention first.
publish.publishedMock: Draft published (demo only, nothing was sent to a server).

prereq.workshop: At least one active workshop with an upcoming session

publish.submitDisabled: Complete the checklist to submit your website for review.
publish.fixTheme: Fix the theme colours with low contrast first.
